action.instructions: Using only the market facts and the virtual position in `request`, choose a cautious simulated action. BUY only when short-term trend and recent momentum are positive without an overheated RSI. SELL only when the virtual account owns the asset and trend/momentum is weakening. Otherwise choose HOLD. This is only a paper-trading signal, not investment advice.

criteria.BUY: Positive short-term trend and momentum, with RSI not overheated; consider a small simulated buy.
criteria.SELL: A virtual position exists and market trend or momentum is weakening; consider a simulated exit.
criteria.HOLD: Mixed, weak, or unclear evidence, no suitable action, or no virtual position to sell.
